name: Youth Volunteer at Sutter Mills-Peninsula Medical Center
city: Burlingame, CA (1501 Trousdale Drive) and San Mateo, CA (100 South San Mateo Drive)
what_you_do: You help patients of all ages and hospital staff after school, on weekends, or during summer and school breaks. You are interviewed before you start.
who_can_apply: High school students 16 and 17 years old. You need a consent form signed by a parent or guardian and one signed by a teacher.
duration: At least one 3 to 4 hour visit a week, with a one-year minimum commitment
deadline_text: Applications open for two weeks twice a year: May 1 to 15 and November 1 to 15. Next window: November 1, 2026 to November 15, 2026.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online form during the two week window. Add the parent form and the teacher form. Both are on the page. Then you do an interview, online training and health tests. Questions? Email MPHSvolunteerservices@sutterhealth.org or call 650-696-2465 and press 2.
notes: Read on the official Sutter Health listing on 2026-10-16. The page gives the windows as May 1 to 15 and November 1 to 15 every year, without a year; the next one falls on Nov 1 to 15, 2026. Applications outside the windows are not described. Get the parent and teacher forms signed before Nov 1 so you can apply on day one. Health testing is required but the listing does not list which shots or tests.
